I edited the existing file instead of adding a new migration. That's the project's rule for the notifier: it hasn't launched yet (launch is planned for November 2026), so none of its migrations have been applied to a shared database. Nothing else in the notifier uses the misspelled column name, so no other code needed changing. Before launch, though, anyone who already applied this migration to a local database will need to re-create it to pick up the new column name.
